```{r display vineland calculated scores for the bold study, ft.align="left"}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis

fq("sections/cognition/latex/vineland.tex", type = "input")

vineland_labels <- c(
  "Total Score",
  "Communication",
  "Daily Living",
  "Socialization"
)

vineland_df %>%
  BRIDGE21:::format_date(!!date_expr) %>%
  BRIDGE21::flex_table(
    widths = 1.3,
    col_labels = c("Date", vineland_labels),
    footers = "Max Score: 100"
  )

fq(type = "newpage")
```
